component.name: unpakt
component.summary: Install and manage AppImages, tarballs and packages per user

description.p: unpakt installs portable Linux apps (AppImages, tarballs and deb, rpm and pacman packages) for your user account from a file, a download URL or a GitHub repository, and adds them to your application menu and command path.
Installed apps can be updated, rolled back to their previous version or removed again, from the app list or the command line.
